dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji equates the use of mantra by American Indians with the use in yoga.  He elaborates on Guru, God ,and the True Self.  He emphasizes the personal nature of sãdhana but broadens the definition of sādhana to include many activiites that are spiritual in nature.

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Babaji teaches us about doing sadhana as he defines it by the mind's inactivity rather than by the activity of sitting.  He discusses how the value of life needs to affect our potential behaviors and how to use positive actions and thoughts to counter negativity. He discusses the symbolism of the image of Kālī.

dc.title: 1977-05-22 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji discussed using the present moment to increase positivity and sattva, through surrender, yoga practices, and acceptance to ensure a better future. Prayer and Regular Sadhana are additional vehicles for this.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-05-28 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji approaches the topic of deciveness from several directions.  He first distinguishes between a determined and decisive effort that is tāmasika (for power, ego gratification, etc), vs. a sāttvika effort.  He then expounds on the methods to achieve decisiveness; from the need to remove fear, the understanding of the aim of non-duality, the use of Kriy Yoga for the purpose, and the kinds of obstaces one faces.  Other issues include being a role model for children.

dc.title: 1977-06-12 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: This darśana involved many short statements, offered by the transcriptionist as aphorisms on a varitety of topics. Included among them were several related to sleeping, various behaviors affecting sādhana, and others related to prāṇāyāma.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION

dc.title: 1977-06-19 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Baba Hari Dass discusses spiritual freedom, the nature of desires, and the importance of mind purification. He explains that true liberation comes from dispassion, not attachment, and emphasizes that enlightenment is realizing one's true self, free from projections like fear and desire.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-06-26 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In darśana, Baba Hari Dass discusses the importance of inner purification for attaining peace, explaining that dispassion, compassion, and positive qualities support spiritual growth. He emphasizes the role of regular sādhana, proper diet, meditation techniques, and overcoming desires in achieving spiritual progress and self-realization.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-07-10 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Baba Hari Dass explains that faith and devotion are developed through positive qualities, concentration, and sādhana. He discusses realization, the importance of controlling desires, and the role of prāṇāyāma in meditation. He also addresses the nature of samādhi, saṃskāras, and the stages of spiritual progress.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Lāhirī Mahāśaya||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-07-17 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji discusses the importance of loving God through His creation, the need for moderation in diet, and the role of sādhana in spiritual progress. He addresses ego, devotion, and the nature of dreams, emphasizing detachment from actions and their consequences in the pursuit of liberation.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-07-24 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji discusses the divine plan, fear, reincarnation, and the nature of the mind. He emphasizes that enlightenment reveals the truth, that ego must be overcome, and that yoga practice is focused on the present. He also speaks on karmic relationships and the importance of detachment.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||George Ivanovich Gurdjieff||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Jesus Christ||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-08-07 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Babaji discusses various aspects of yoga, including prāṇāyāma, the nature of the mind, and the importance of sādhana. He emphasizes that true knowledge comes through practice, not intellectual study, and highlights the connection between mind, body, and God.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION

dc.title: 1977-08-14 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this document,Baba Hari Dass discusses the nature of fear, attachment, and duty. He explains that attachment leads to evolution, but also to suffering, and that karma and saṃskāra shape our lives. He emphasizes that spiritual growth requires responsibility, detachment, and finding peace within.

dc.title: 1977-08-21 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Babaji discusses various spiritual topics, including the fear of death, attachment, and karma. He explains the importance of meditation, the role of prāṇa, and the process of reincarnation. He also emphasizes facing fears, cultivating positive qualities, and understanding the cycle of life and death.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-09-04 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji discusses meditation, the nature of fear and death, and the attachment of the subtle body to the physical body. He explains how saṃskāras influence life and death, and touches on possession, liberation, and the cycle of life as a continuous transformation.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Hariakhan Baba Maharaj||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-09-11 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Here Babaji discusses the nature of creation, the symbolism of deities, and the importance of meditation. He emphasizes the role of devotion, silence, and self-awareness in spiritual practice, explaining how attachment, desire, and expectations can be transformed for peace and love.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-09-18 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Babaji discusses spiritual practices, self-enquiry, and desires. He explains that desires, especially negative ones, create mental impressions (saṃskāras) that hinder realization of the Self. He also touches on methods like mantra, yoga, and dhyāna to achieve peace, and mentions Jesus' spiritual practices.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Jesus Christ||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-09-25 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana, Babaji discusses the nature of karma, oneness, and meditation. He emphasizes the importance of controlling attachments, purifying the mind through prāṇāyāma, and understanding pain and pleasure as mental constructs. He also touches on the limits of politics and the role of effort in life’s challenges.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-10-02 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this 10/9/77 satsang, Baba Hari Dass discusses the unity of all religions in realizing the Self and the importance of faith. He explains that yoga transcends religious boundaries, emphasizing personal experience over doctrine. He also highlights the natural return of all souls to God and the benefits of focusing on positive aspects.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Jesus Christ||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-10-09 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: Babaji answers questions about the nature of love, attachment, and judgment. He emphasizes the importance of self-acceptance to avoid comparisons, explains how sādhana brings past saṃskāras to the surface, and offers practical advice on diet, breathing, and spiritual practices to balance energies and health.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-10-16 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this 10/23/77 satsang, Baba Hari Dass explains the mind’s dual role in trapping and liberating us, the nature of fear, and how meditation can stir energy. He discusses nāda yoga, the significance of bodily humors, and the connection between emotions, body, and prāṇāyāma for spiritual development.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-10-23 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this 10/30/77 satsang, Baba Hari Dass discusses selfless action (karma yoga), the mind’s role in attachment, and the relationship between consciousness, energy, and matter. He emphasizes overcoming fear, the value of equanimity, meditation on death, and the importance of non-attachment for spiritual progress.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-10-30 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In darśana, Baba Hari Dass discusses Mānasa Yoga, emphasizing the importance of concentration, prāṇāyāma, and the connection between consciousness, energy, and matter. He addresses spiritual concepts like duality, the mind's role, and the use of metals for worship. He also speaks on the evolution of sādhana and enlightenment.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Charles Darwin||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Hariakhan Baba Maharaj||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-11-06 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In the 11/13/77 satsang, Baba Hari Dass discusses concepts like the nature of the soul, the role of desire in creation, and the importance of purifying the mind through virtues or sādhana. He addresses impatience, good and bad company, and the spiritual responsibility of individuals, emphasizing the importance of inner purity.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-11-13 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In the 11/20/77 satsang, Baba Hari Dass discusses controlling desires through discipline, emphasizing tantra as a means to use the senses for mastery over them. He addresses the nature of saṃskāras, the evolution of souls, and the importance of dispassion in spiritual practice, noting that sādhana leads to non-attachment.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-11-20 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In this darśana Baba Hari Dass discusses dispassion and devotion in yoga, noting that samādhi and dispassion are interconnected. He explains the effects of fasting, the body's natural healing powers, and the role of energy transmission in spiritual awakening. He also touches on justice as an individual understanding of right and wrong.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-12-04 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In the 12/11/77 satsang, Babaji Hari discusses yoga, meditation, and dispassion. He emphasizes the importance of meditation for mental calm, the use of mantras, and freeing the mind from negative thoughts. He explains that attachment, marriage, and societal roles are necessary at certain stages of spiritual evolution.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
dc.subject.person: Baba Hari Dass||Chetana Mary Jennings||Hamsa Robin Heinrich||Shankar Clark Heinrich
dc.title: 1977-12-11 Satsang

dc.creator: Baba Hari Dass
dc.description: In satsang darśana, Baba Hari Dass discusses meditation, samādhi, and spiritual practices. He emphasizes the importance of faith, the role of the guru, and the need for discipline to overcome attachment and desires. He also addresses the relationship between ego, body, and higher consciousness in spiritual evolution.
dc.subject: HUMANITIES and RELIGION
